g.text: load factor hardcoded to 1.0 in SolverEventData
overwrites step count for entire stage

svg.text: Bug 1 — deltaF uses wrong reference: F_ext_start may not be zero at stage 0, and is never correctly primed between stages
Bug 2 — U_converged(fixed_dofs) mutated before newtonLoop; bisect re-sends the mutated (wrong alpha) position
Bug 3 — no commitHistory() call: plastic strain resets every step (confirmed by Systems Report)
Bug 4 — SolverEventData always receives lambda = 1.0 and iters = 5, breaking all listeners
Bug 5 — History_Load = nStep (scalar) silently overwrites stage count each call; multi-stage history lost
Secondary — ReactionHist pre-alloc is cols=30 fixed; overflows silently on longer runs
